ideas.pitch: Early pest and disease outbreak prediction platform using multi-spectral satellite imagery and farmer crowd-sourced image reporting for rural cooperatives.
ideas.title: CropShield AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the Agriculture, Food and Rural development theme with proven computer vision execution similar to past UN hackathon winners, giving rural committees actionable early warnings.

ideas.title: AuditChain Rural

ideas.pitch: Offline-first bookkeeping and automated credit scoring app for micro-entrepreneurs and street vendors operating in semi-urban and rural markets.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Fintech theme with a high-utility local economic problem, focusing on underserved merchants rather than generic consumer wallets.

ideas.title: GridFlow Smart Energy
